explanation: This test only initiates a top-up and checks that the wallet balance increases. It does not verify that the FX rate is locked at initiation, that the funding source is debited only after the wallet is credited, that a timeout rolls back the transaction, or that dual approval is required for top-ups above SGD 10,000. It also lacks any checks on the funding source balance or timing of debits, and does not test any failure or approval scenarios.
missingAssertions: Verify FX rate is locked at top-up initiation
Verify funding source is debited only after wallet is credited
Verify transaction rolls back on provider callback timeout
Verify dual approval is required for top-ups above SGD 10,000
hypothesizedBugThisWouldMiss: A bug where the funding source is debited before the wallet is credited, or where the FX rate changes after initiation, or where a timeout does not roll back the transaction, or where top-ups above SGD 10,000 do not require dual approval.

suggestedReplacement.description: Test wallet top-up with FX rate lock, credit-before-debit, timeout rollback, and dual approval for large amounts
steps: Initiate top-up of SGD 500 with FX rate recorded
Verify FX rate is locked at initiation
Verify wallet balance increases by SGD 500
Verify funding source is debited only after wallet is credited
Simulate provider callback timeout after 5 seconds
Verify transaction is rolled back and balances unchanged
Verify system requests second owner approval before settlement
Verify wallet credited and funding source debited after approval
suggestedReplacement.expectedResult: FX rate is locked at initiation; wallet balance increases before funding source is debited; transaction rolls back on timeout with no balance changes; top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second owner approval before settlement
